map.ΔpH = 目标 − 当前。升 pH 用石灰（以 CaCO₃ 当量计），质地系数: ΔpH = target − current. To raise pH use lime (as CaCO₃ equivalent), with the texture coefficient taken as 0.3 for sandy soil, 0.6 for loam, 1.0 for clay and 1.6 for organic soil, normalised by "plough layer depth ÷ 20 cm". To lower pH use sulphur, multiplying the lime-based formula by 0.4 (pure S basis). The CaO and Ca(OH)₂ equivalents of the lime are also given. When |ΔpH| is below 0.05 it reports that no large adjustment is needed.
